steps.title: Set heat block temperature
steps.instruction: Turn on the heat block and set it to 37 °C.

steps.title: Label microcentrifuge tubes
steps.instruction: Label clean 0.5 mL microcentrifuge tubes with the SampleID by writing directly on the tube lid with a fine‑point Sharpie.

steps.title: Retrieve and thaw reagents
steps.instruction: Remove one aliquot each of stock AciI enzyme, stock BseYI enzyme, and NEBuffer r3.1 from the freezer; vortex gently to mix and spin down in a mini‑spinner if necessary.

steps.title: Prepare enzyme working solution
steps.instruction: In a 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube combine 62 µL NEBuffer r3.1, 62 µL stock AciI enzyme, and 62 µL stock BseYI enzyme to make the AciI/BseYI working solution.

steps.title: Add enzyme mix and template
steps.instruction: Aliquot 1.5 µL of the AciI/BseYI working solution into the bottom of each labeled 0.5 mL tube, then add 5 µL mtORF amplicon to each tube, double‑checking that the correct sample is added to the correct tube.

steps.title: Mix and spin down
steps.instruction: Flick each tube gently to mix, then spin down the tubes in a mini‑spinner.

steps.title: Incubate digestion
steps.instruction: Incubate all tubes at 37 °C for 60 minutes, then raise the temperature to 80 °C for 20 minutes.

steps.title: Analyze or store digests
steps.instruction: If possible, visualize the digests immediately on an agarose gel; otherwise, store the tubes in a refrigerator.
